title: Zule schedule configuration
description: Draft configuration for a repeating, single-core schedule. All timing uses integer slots. Each window reserves its referenced task's budget; early completion does not advance subsequent windows. Unallocated slots are idle.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this configuration's JSON Schema.

slot_us.description: Duration of one slot in microseconds.

tasks.description: Task definitions keyed by names with distinct uppercase forms for generated enum constants.

budget_slots.description: Reserved wall-clock duration of each invocation in slots. The task must complete within this window, allowing for scheduler and interrupt interference.

slots.description: Total cycle length in slots, including idle time. The schedule repeats at this interval.

windows.description: Execution windows in increasing start-slot order. A task may appear more than once. Each window's duration comes exclusively from the referenced task's budget_slots.

start_slot.description: Start offset from the cycle boundary in slots. The window occupies [start_slot, start_slot + task budget_slots).
